profile_text.body:
Course Hero describes itself as a study platform offering instant access to millions of study resources, course notes, test prep material, 24/7 homework help, and tutors. Its stated purpose is to let students learn, teach, and study, and to get unstuck. The site identifies the company as a Learneo, Inc. business and states that Course Hero is not sponsored or endorsed by any college or university. The company was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Redwood City.

The only AI product in the record is QuillBot, a paraphrasing tool. No lawsuits, MCP servers, or SEC or patent facts are held for the company.
